description: React component for a modal dialog displaying detailed session information, including user details, timestamps, and session metadata, with utility functions for formatting and data resolution.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date value into a localized string or em-dash if invalid or missing.

methods.name: computeDuration
methods.description: Calculates a human-readable duration string from start and end timestamps.

methods.name: resolveUserName
methods.description: Resolves a user-friendly name from various user reference formats, searching in context data.

methods.name: pickFrom
methods.description: Utility to safely extract the first defined value from an object given multiple key options.
